title: US 30-year bond reaches highs since 2002 and drags Wall Street lower
summary: The 30-year bond yield surpasses 2002 levels, driven by persistent inflation and expectations of higher rates, which weighed on US stock markets.

title: Asian stocks close mixed amid pressure from US yields and oil
summary: Markets in Japan, China, Hong Kong, India, Thailand, and Indonesia show volatility as investors digest US rate hikes and rising crude prices.

title: Nikkei rebounds 837 points driven by semiconductor optimism
summary: TDK and Taiyo Yuden shares lead gains in Tokyo after the rise in US chips, taking the index to 33,118 points.

title: Nidec negotiates sale of its components unit to Carlyle for $636 million
summary: The Japanese group confirms talks to divest its former subsidiary Copal Electronics, in a deal valued at over 1 billion yen.

title: Julius Baer surges in stock market after Swiss regulator closes investigation
summary: FINMA closes the case against the private bank, removing legal uncertainty and triggering a record rise in its shares.

title: OpenAI delays launch of its most advanced AI due to safety issues
summary: Sam Altman announces that the 'GPT-5' model will not be released until risks are resolved, as the company prioritizes safety over commercial speed.

title: A leak suggests Anthropic is preparing its IPO
summary: Internal documents reveal plans for an IPO valued at $30 billion, following in OpenAI's footsteps in the generative AI race.

title: Bloom Energy multiplies its value by 16 in five years and leads S&P 500 gains
summary: The hydrogen fuel cell manufacturer sees all its appreciation concentrated in the last two fiscal years, driven by the energy transition.

title: Euribor rises again and will close September above 3%
summary: The benchmark index for mortgages in Spain resumes its upward path amid ECB fears of persistent inflation.
